description: High-speed drift_drl turn: reward the worst of four ground-normal two-wheel load-reserve costs in each 20ms policy step. Same original004 parent, pinned turn reference, 2048 environments, 600 updates, seed42, 50/200Hz clocks, friction, motor-v1 randomization, controller and frozen two-engine gate. Versus last-substep load-reserve retry, sampling and cost weight both change; no one-factor causal attribution is claimed.
